name: pesarattu wrap
instructions:
The pesarattu mash ([[pesarattu]] batter made thick — food processor, no water) used as a SPREAD — in a baked WRAP or a QUESADILLA (both formats are fine; use MORE CHEESE in the quesadilla because it's dry).

WORK IN PROGRESS — the build is still being dialed in (it runs dry and wants fat + vinegar; the street-food layer below is the current direction).

=== THE BUILD ===

- THE VEHICLE: a BAKEABLE FLATBREAD / MEDITERRANEAN WRAP for the wrap format, brushed with GHEE (frankie logic — street rolls are griddled in fat, not baked dry); or TORTILLAS for the QUESADILLA format — with MORE CHEESE, because the quesadilla runs dry.
- PESARATTU MASH as the spread; [[mint-cilantro-yogurt]] as the second spread opposite it.
- BAKED CHICKEN + POTATO — bake or MICROWAVE the potato FIRST, before it goes in the wrap (best method found).
- TURMERIC RICE ([[turmeric-rice]]).
- YOGURT — and JAM/CHUTNEY goes well alongside it.
- CILANTRO.
- CHEDDAR CHEESE — the wildcard that's really good (go heavier in the quesadilla format).
- THE STREET-FOOD LAYER: PICKLED RED ONIONS (the vinegar, inside an ingredient pesarattu already wants), [[jam-chutney]] and/or TAMARIND CHUTNEY (sweet-sour), and a dusting of AMCHUR or CHAAT MASALA over the chicken/potato.

Assemble and bake.
notes:
=== WRAP OR QUESADILLA — BOTH FINE (THE QUESADILLA VERDICT REVERSED) ===

The pesarattu-quesadilla idea (bake the no-water mash between tortillas) was originally judged a failure — too dry. CHANGED MY MIND: it's fine in a quesadilla. WRAPS OR QUESADILLAS ARE BOTH FINE — just use MORE CHEESE for the quesadilla, because it's dry. Either way the pesarattu mash is a GREAT SPREAD: baked chicken/potato with turmeric rice, yogurt, cilantro, and cheddar.

=== THE VEHICLE PER FORMAT ===

WRAP format: a BAKEABLE FLATBREAD / MEDITERRANEAN WRAP (a tortilla doesn't work as the wrap). QUESADILLA format: tortillas, with the extra cheese doing the moisture work.

=== CHEDDAR — THE WILDCARD ===

Cheddar cheese is the wildcard here, and it's really good. Dose it up in the quesadilla format.

=== YOGURT + JAM/CHUTNEY ===

In addition to the yogurt, this goes well with JAM/CHUTNEY ([[jam-chutney]] and/or tamarind chutney).

=== WORK IN PROGRESS ===

This recipe is a WORK IN PROGRESS. First build ran DRY and needed FAT and VINEGAR — the street-food additions (ghee on the bread, mint-cilantro-yogurt, pickled red onions, jam/tamarind chutney, amchur/chaat masala) are the current direction for fixing it.

=== THE POTATO — COOK IT FIRST ===

Bake or MICROWAVE the potato FIRST before putting it in the wrap — found to be best.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[pesarattu]]: the parent — the mash is its batter made thick in a food processor without water.
- [[turmeric-rice]]: the rice component.
